tool.name: Mutation Designer
tool.description: recommend substitutions and compact smart libraries for ranked hotspot residues
tool.command: \${HOTSPOT_WIZARD_PYTHON:-python} '$__tool_directory__/run_mutation_designer.py' --hotspots-tsv '$hotspots_tsv' --msa-fasta '$msa_fasta' --protein-sequence '$protein_sequence' --candidate-mutations 'candidate_mutations.tsv' --smart-library 'smart_library.tsv' --degenerate-codons 'degenerate_codons.tsv' --run-log 'run_log.txt' --top-n-hotspots '$top_n_hotspots' --min-hotspot-score '$min_hotspot_score' --min-msa-frequency '$min_msa_frequency' --max-suggestions-per-site '$max_suggestions_per_site' --smart-library-max-sites '$smart_library_max_sites' --reduced-alphabet '$reduced_alphabet' --max-reduced-suggestions-per-site '$max_reduced_suggestions_per_site' #if str($reference.reference_mode) == "sequence_id": --msa-reference-id '$reference.msa_reference_id' #end if #if str($include_natural) == "true": --include-natural #else --no-include-natural #end if #if str($include_consensus) == "true": --include-consensus #else --no-include-consensus #end if #if str($include_conservative) == "true": --include-conservative #else --no-include-conservative #end if #if str($include_alanine) == "true": --include-alanine #else --no-include-alanine #end if #if str($include_reduced_alphabet) == "true": --include-reduced-alphabet #else --no-include-reduced-alphabet #end if #if str($include_wt_in_library) == "true": --include-wt-in-library #else --no-include-wt-in-library #end if #if str($avoid_cysteine) == "true": --avoid-cysteine #else --no-avoid-cysteine #end if

param.name: hotspots_tsv
param.label: hotspot_residue_ranked.tsv
param.help: Output from Tool 6 Hotspot Residue Ranker.

param.name: msa_fasta
param.label: msa.fasta
param.help: Multiple sequence alignment from Tool 3 Homolog Search and MSA.

param.name: protein_sequence
param.label: protein_sequence.fasta
param.help: Ungapped target protein sequence used to map hotspot positions onto MSA columns.

param.name: reference_mode
param.label: MSA reference sequence
param.option: Auto: exact sequence match, otherwise first MSA record

param.name: msa_reference_id
param.label: MSA reference ID
param.help: Must match the FASTA identifier before the first whitespace.

param.name: top_n_hotspots
param.label: Top N hotspot residues to design

param.name: min_msa_frequency
param.label: Minimum MSA frequency for natural substitutions

param.name: max_suggestions_per_site
param.label: Maximum suggested amino acids per site

param.name: include_natural
param.label: Use naturally observed amino acids from MSA

param.name: include_reduced_alphabet
param.label: Include reduced amino acid alphabet suggestions

param.name: reduced_alphabet
param.label: Reduced amino acid alphabet
param.help: One-letter amino acid codes used for exploratory reduced-library suggestions.

param.name: avoid_cysteine
param.label: Avoid new cysteine suggestions unless already selected by WT/library design

param.name: include_wt_in_library
param.label: Include wild-type amino acid in degenerate codon target set

param.name: smart_library_max_sites
param.label: Maximum sites in pooled multi-site smart-library row

tool.help:
用途说明 --------
本工具是 HotSpot Wizard-like 蛋白半理性改造流程的 Tool 7。它接收 Tool 6 输出的 `hotspot_residue_ranked.tsv`、Tool 3 输出的 `msa.fasta` 以及目标蛋白 FASTA，为 hotspot 位点推荐候选氨基酸替换，并给出 smart library 与简并密码子设计表。
推荐突变来源 ------------
- 同源序列中自然出现过的氨基酸：来自 MSA 每列的氨基酸频率。 - consensus amino acid：优先采用 Tool 6/Tool 4 表中传递的共识氨基酸。 - 同理化性质替换：例如疏水换疏水、芳香换芳香、带电换带电。 - alanine scanning：用于快速检查侧链贡献。 - reduced amino acid alphabet：用于构建较小但多样的探索性突变库。
主要输出 --------
**candidate_mutations.tsv** 每一行是一个推荐替换，包含 `position`、`wt_aa`、`suggested_aa`、`reason`、`msa_frequency`、`mutation_type`、`hotspot_score` 等字段。
**smart_library.tsv** 每个位点的推荐氨基酸集合、理论库容量、推荐简并密码子；第一行还会给出 top sites 的 pooled multi-site library 估算。
**degenerate_codons.tsv** 每个位点的简并密码子、覆盖氨基酸、额外引入氨基酸、缺失氨基酸和覆盖率。该表用于后续引物/文库设计复核。
注意事项 --------
- 这是候选突变设计工具，不等同于稳定性或功能预测。建议后续接 FoldX/Rosetta、实验筛选或文献知识继续过滤。 - MSA 质量会直接影响 natural/consensus 推荐。低质量 MSA 可能导致推荐偏差。 - 简并密码子会尽量避免终止密码子，但为了覆盖目标集合，可能引入额外氨基酸；请检查 `extra_aas` 字段。
